scenicChapters.title: Seven Passes Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 172 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
